reason: E2 directly states that vertical cracks were expected due to the absence of preheating and that raising build space temperature is the most common approach to minimize cracking, supporting the link between preheating and crack reduction. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides specific evidence that preheating to 500 °C reduces thermal gradients, residual stresses, or improves dimensional precision and mechanical integrity in HEAs; E1 discusses undissolved particles and mechanical properties without mentioning preheating.

Reduced thermal gradients minimize residual stresses and cracking
Reduced cracking improves dimensional precision and mechanical integrity
Preheating to ~500 °C is effective for SLM/DED of HEAs
